description:
Internet Download Manager (IDM) is a tool to increase download speeds by up to 5 times, resume and schedule downloads.


- Accelerated muxing of audio and video streams for large MKV files, writing directly to the final output file without an intermediate assembly step
- Fixed a problem causing IDM download panel not to appear on some websites
- Fixed issues with resuming the download of certain TS videos
- Fixed issues when converting certain TS videos to MP4
- Fixed bugs
